title: Statement 2: well-definedness, injectivity, and squeeze property of the map f

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** problem.tex, 'The Domain' and 'The Map'.

1. **Domain & beta bound.** Verify the fundamental domain $\Omega'=\Sigma/G_\beta$ (three clean triangles $T'_0,T'_\pm$ plus four parallelograms) is genuinely a fundamental domain for the glide reflection $G_\beta$, and that the centerline-length bookkeeping ($3\mu/2=\sqrt3$ plus $O(\epsilon^2)$ contributions) gives $\beta<\sqrt3+\epsilon$.
2. **Well-defined PA map.** The combinatorially identical triangulations of $\Omega'$ and $\Omega$ determine $\overline f$; prove it is continuous (affine pieces agree on shared edges), injective (uses embeddedness of $\Omega$ from the previous issue), and that the lift $f=\overline f\circ\pi$ has $f(p)=f(q)\iff p,q$ in the same $G$-orbit.
3. **Squeeze on every triangle.** For $\epsilon<1/100$, verify the *strict* squeeze property (distinguished edge shortened, other two edges lengthened) on every triangle, including the diagonal-cut thin triangles: on $T'_k$ crosscutting edges $<\mu+\epsilon^2<$ distinguished, mapped to edges of length $\mu+\epsilon^2$; on thin triangles distinguished edges $\le 2\epsilon^3<\epsilon^2$ and crosscutting $\ge\mu+\epsilon^2$. Confirm short diagonals are $<\mu+\epsilon^2$.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
I reviewed the three sub-points of this issue against the current Section 5 (Proof of Statement 2). All three are addressed substantively and correctly, and I numerically verified every quantitative estimate for the full range eps in (0,1/100). I found and fixed ONE concrete defect (an arithmetic slip in the beta bound).

**1. Domain & beta bound — VERIFIED (with one fix).**
- Fundamental-domain property: P (= S'_- T'_- R'_- T'_0 R'_+ T'_+ S'_+) spans the full height 1; its left/right boundaries L_-, L_+ are anti-parallel length-sigma segments identified by the orientation-reversing isometry G_beta(x,y)=(x+beta,1-y); consecutive translates glue along L_pm, tiling Sigma with disjoint interiors. So Omega' = Sigma/G_beta is a flat Moebius band. Argued correctly in the draft.
- **Arithmetic error found and fixed in eq:(beta).** The draft wrote
  beta = 3(mu/2 + eps^2) + 2·eps^2 + 2·2eps^2 = 3mu/2 + 7eps^2.
  The eps^2 coefficients literally sum to 3+2+4 = 9, not 7; also the loose bound b/2 <= mu/2+eps^2 was unnecessary. The EXACT centreline bookkeeping with b = mu + (3/2)eps^2 (b/2 = mu/2 + (3/4)eps^2) gives
  beta = w = 3·(b/2) + (2eps^2 + 4eps^2) = 3mu/2 + (33/4)eps^2 = sqrt3 + (33/4)eps^2.
  Since (33/4)eps^2 < (33/4)(eps/100) < eps for eps < 1/100, beta < sqrt3 + eps still holds. I rewrote eq:(beta) as an exact equality with coefficient 33/4 and added per-piece chord accounting.
- Verified mu < sigma < mu+eps^2 (slant bound) and b > sigma > mu (so distinguished base is the strictly longest side: genuinely 'wide') over the whole eps-range.

**2. Well-defined PA map — VERIFIED.**
- Continuity: vertex assignment is a bijection, so each vertex has one image; triangles sharing [u,v] map to triangles sharing [f(u),f(v)] and affine restrictions agree on the edge (affine map of a segment fixed by endpoint values); gluing lemma => continuity. Correct.
- Injectivity: factored as (a) abstract PL homeomorphism Omega' -> M, then (b) realisation M -> Omega ⊂ R^3, injective because Omega is embedded (non-consecutive pieces disjoint; consecutive meet only along prescribed length-(mu+eps^2) edges). Correct; uses embeddedness as required.
- Lift property: f = fbar∘pi gives f(p)=f(q) <=> pi(p)=pi(q) <=> q ∈ G·p (P a fundamental domain, only identification L_- ~ L_+). Yields (i) invariance, (ii) injectivity-on-orbits. Correct.

**3. Strict squeeze on every triangle — VERIFIED.**
- Wide T'_k: base b=mu+(3/2)eps^2 -> mu+eps^2 (shortened); slant sigma<mu+eps^2 -> mu+eps^2 (lengthened).
- Thin connector triangles (short-diagonal cut): distinguished s in {eps^2,2eps^2} -> <=2eps^3 (shortened, 2eps^3<eps^2); slant sigma -> mu+eps^2 (lengthened); short diagonal delta=sqrt((c-s)^2+1) -> range diagonal sqrt((mu+eps^2)^2+(<=2eps^3)^2) >= mu+eps^2 (lengthened). Short diagonals satisfy delta < sigma < mu+eps^2 since 0<s<c=sqrt(sigma^2-1) (c>1/sqrt3≈0.577 >> 2eps^2). Verified numerically for all eps in (0,1/100).
- Confirmed R_0's range short sides are sqrt(2)·eps^3 < 2eps^3.

Net: the only substantive issue was 7eps^2 vs the correct 33/4 eps^2 (now fixed as an exact equality in solution.tex). With that fix, well-definedness, continuity, injectivity, the lift/orbit property, the fundamental-domain property, the beta<sqrt3+eps bound, and the strict squeeze on every triangle are all established. Resolving.
